Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Tax Charge; Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Tax Charge. | CRON 20261001: EPS row added from the audited FY2025 results (year ended 31 Dec 2025): basic EPS KES 3.45, FY2024 2.36; ties to the stored Net Profit 2,170,880,000 against Profit Before Tax 3,867,060,000 less Income Tax 1,696,180,000 | CRON 20261002: revenue restated to the printed net revenue base (revenue from contracts with customers less indirect taxes and duties) so the printed gross profit and the published gross margin tie; gross profit, operating profit and the three margins corrected off that base. | CRON 20261108: FY2023 and FY2022 columns added from the audited statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 109 of the TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC Annual Report and Financial Statements 2023, KShs thousands scaled to absolute KES. FY2023: revenue from contracts with customers 156,432,095; indirect taxes and duties 35,713,695; net revenue 120,718,400; cost of sales 107,882,717; gross profit 12,835,683; other income 2,071,216; operating expenses 8,040,363; net allowance for expected credit losses 433,816; finance income 890,932; finance costs 2,319,090; net foreign exchange loss 385,142; profit before tax 4,619,420; tax 1,596,496; profit 3,022,924; basic and diluted EPS 4.48. FY2022: net revenue 102,802,416; cost of sales 93,222,522; gross profit 9,579,894; other income 1,581,647; operating expenses 7,119,539; expected credit losses 33,219; finance income 567,259; finance costs 919,890; net foreign exchange gain 146,842; profit before tax 3,802,994; tax 1,358,667; profit 2,444,327; EPS 3.88. Every column ties: gross profit less operating expenses equals the printed operating profit, profit before tax reconciles through other income, expected credit losses, net finance costs and net foreign exchange, and profit before tax less tax equals the printed profit. Ratios use the printed equity, total assets and total liabilities of the same audited statement of financial position (2023 KShs 32,225,023 and 75,315,472 thousand; 2022 KShs 30,230,449 and 73,043,134 thousand).
